# er fixtures

- `basic.mmd` and `attributes.mmd` follow the examples in the Mermaid
  entity relationship diagram documentation
  (https://mermaid.js.org/syntax/entityRelationshipDiagram.html), MIT
  licensed, © Knut Sveidqvist and contributors.
- `legacy-sample.mmd` is the ER sample shipped with mermaid-svg 0.7.0
  (`crates/nana-ui-runtime/tests/fixtures/mermaid/er.mmd`), MIT licensed.
- `aliases-styles.mmd` and `cjk-long.mmd` are written for this crate:
  aliases, every cardinality, styles, CJK names and long comments.
